description.zh: 是否支持文件存储挂载
description.en: Specifies whether file storage mounting is supported.

description.zh: 节点组的默认镜像id，如果不设置，那么就不会改变。
description.en: The default image ID of the node group. If this parameter is not specified, the image remains unchanged.

description.zh: 节点组内机器的登录密码
description.en: The logon password of the machines in the node group.

description.zh:
节点 RAM 角色名称。您可以使用 RAM API ListRoles 查询您已创建的节点 RAM 角色。设置的角色的信任主体必须为“智能计算灵骏”。
注意：当前暂不支持将已有角色清空。
description.en:
The RAM role name of the node. You can call the RAM API ListRoles to query the node RAM roles that you have created. The trusted entity of the role must be set to Lingjun AI Computing Service.
Note: Clearing an existing role is not supported.

description.zh: 自定义可执行shell脚本，需要以 Base64 方式编码，原始数据最多为 16 KB。
description.en: The custom executable shell script. The script must be Base64-encoded. The maximum size of the raw data is 16 KB.

descriptions.zh: 创建会话的接口，返回前端EndPoint，并且起一个周期任务跟踪会话状态
descriptions.en: Creates a session, returns the frontend endpoint, and starts a periodic task to track the session status.
